about_the_game:
Coaster Architect is a roller coaster building puzzle game. In a series of different levels you are challenged to build the optimal roller coaster taking the terrain and a set of collectibles into account. Be wary of physics, though: Too high speeds combined with too tight curves or slopes and your coaster will turn into a rocket. 

The building tool is incredibly simple and intuitive and designed in a way that allows you to build your own coasters within seconds. No complicated UI, no steep learning curve, doesn't feel like work.

Build your way through various kinds of challenges spread out over different colorful environments. Along your journey new mechanics and obstacles are introduced which will require increasingly creative roller coaster designs. 

In a sea of roller coaster simulations, this game wants to provide a fresh and original experience and dares to explore new frontiers. Relax and take a step into this weird and wonderful world of roller coasters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4-core 1.7 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R9 380 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4-core 2.9 GHz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070, Radeon RX 5700 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Roller coaster design puzzle meets physics sandbox. In a series of increasingly challenging levels your task is to get creative and build all kinds of crazy coasters. Don't get too crazy, though, or physics will turn your coaster into a rocket.
